name: PennyLane RX/RY QNode Jacobian at (a,b)=(1.0,2.0) three ways
task_prompt: Define a two-parameter PennyLane QNode applying RX(a), RY(b), and returning the vector (<X>,<Z>). At (a,b)=(1.0,2.0), compute qml.jacobian, a manual parameter-shift Jacobian for each parameter, and a central finite-difference Jacobian. Use trainable pennylane.numpy arrays, print all derivatives, and assert pairwise agreement within 1e-7. Output code only as a self-contained Python program. Use documented public APIs, require no cloud credentials, make stochastic behavior reproducible, and include executable checks with justified tolerances.
